title: Marine Corps Half Marathon
intro: Experience the storied legacy of the Marine Corps at the Marine Corps Half Marathon on Camp Lejeune. This flat and picturesque course offers runners breathtaking views of the New River, Morgan Bay, and Farnell Bay.

sections.markdown:
**SOLD OUT**

**September 19, 2026 | 7AM | MCB Camp Lejeune**

Presented by FirstLight Home Care and USAA

sections.heading: Course Details
sections.markdown:
You will travel between the fairways of the Paradise Point Golf Course, where the Heroes Mile pays homage to fallen service members. The Marine Corps Half Marathon offers an unparalleled opportunity to honor tradition while embracing the natural beauty of Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune.

_This course is not USATF certified._

**This race is open to the public.**

sections.heading: Base Access Requirements
sections.markdown:
The pass-request deadline has now passed, but base access requirements remain in effect for all participants and spectators.

Due to increased security measures, the Trusted Traveler Program has been suspended. All runners and spectators ages 18+ who do not have a valid DoW ID with credentialed base access MUST have a base pass.

sections.heading: Spectator Information
sections.markdown:
**Cheer on runners!** Not running but want to support this year's participants? Runners love seeing spectators along the course — and those handmade signs always give them an extra boost. Your presence helps create a great atmosphere for every athlete pushing toward the finish. Roads will be closing early, so get in position bright and early and check the course map to find your perfect cheering spot. For questions or additional information, please email mccslejeunesemperfitraces@usmc-mccs.org.

_Base access is required._

sections.heading: Registration Requirements
sections.markdown:
- Must be 14yrs+ to register
- All runners must complete the race within 3.75 hours
- This course is not a USATF certified course
- Only registered runners are allowed on the course
- No pets allowed on the course

sections.heading: Awards
sections.markdown:
**ALL FINISHERS WILL RECEIVE A FINISHER MEDAL**

- Overall Awards will be given to the top 3 overall male and female finishers
- Overall Masters Awards will be given to the top 3 overall male and female finishers ages 40 and up
- 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place medals will be given to the top 3 male and female finishers in each age bracket: (14-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65+)

Note: Overall winners will receive an Overall plaque award and Overall placement medal. Overall award winners are not eligible to also place in their age category.

sections.heading: Hydration and Fuel Available on Course
sections.markdown:
**Hydration:** Powerade and water

**Gels:** UnTapped Energy Gels in Salted Cocoa and Salted Citrus varieties will be available on the course. UnTapped is a leading provider of all-natural athletic nutrition. Made with pure maple syrup, UnTapped gels are easily digestible nutrition that provides athletes with great tasting, long lasting energy.

sections.heading: Installation Access Instructions
sections.markdown:
ALL RUNNERS AND ALL PASSENGERS (18YRS AND OVER) NEEDING A BASE PASS must complete the instructions below AFTER race registration has been completed.

Due to increased security measures, the Trusted Traveler Program has been suspended. All runners and spectators who do not currently possess a valid DoW ID with credentialed base access will need to obtain an event base access pass.

1. Register for a base pass at https://www1.mcieast.usmc.mil/IARA/
2. Locate the event and select "Request Sponsor"
3. Agree to the Privacy Act Statement
4. Select the Visitor Type drop down menu and choose either driver or passenger
5. Complete the registration. Please have the following information available:
   - **Drivers:** Social Security number, DOB, email, phone number, driver's license, auto insurance policy, and auto information
   - **Passengers:** Social Security number, DOB, government ID, email, and phone number

**Deadline to submit information is 30 days prior to the event date.** No additional event passes will be issued past this date. Registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable if you do not request a pass by the deadline.

Once approved, your pass(es) will be available for pick up at the Visitor's Gate the morning of the race. The pass is only good for the day of the event. Registered runners will receive more information on how to receive their pass(es) the week prior to the race.

**REAL ID Requirements:** All visitors with non-REAL ID driver's license and State issued identification cards requesting access to MCIEAST-MCB Camp Lejeune or MCAS New River must provide an approved identity source document or combination thereof to access the installation(s).

An example of identity source documentation includes a U.S. passport, or the combination of an original or certified true copy of a birth certificate bearing a raised seal, social security card, and non-REAL ID compliant driver's license or State issued identification card – all three documents must bear the same name.

For questions on the REAL ID, contact Base Security at 910-450-0282.
